_about: Sibling annotation for metrics.json. It is a SEPARATE file on purpose: metrics.json is
driver-produced and carries run_commit 6b242cfb..., so hand-editing it would add content that
commit did not produce -- the mirror image of restamping a run_commit without re-running, which
spec 4.5 forbids. Nothing here overrides the artifact; it classifies which of its fields the
4.74.0 geometry change did and did not touch.
This artifact was NOT re-run. The reason is measured, not assumed: see cites.covariate_invariance.

why: Layer 2's treatment is gk_depth_x >= 16.5 via _covariate_depth (opportunities.py:393), and
gk_depth_x = GK_r * cos(GK_theta). Both factors are EXACTLY invariant under the geometry
change -- hypot(a,-b) == hypot(a,b) and cos is even -- measured at 0.0 on both axes and both
goal ends by scripts/measure_covariate_invariance.py. The treated SET is therefore identical,
so every count and the estimability verdict N_MIN_MATCHED are unchanged.
theta IS in LAYER2_BUILD_CONFOUNDERS (opportunities.py:150) and moves 2.6202 rad at
goal_x=105 (axis A). It is a per-spell STORED column, so the persisted spells parquet is
stale in theta, not merely the analysis-time design matrix. Re-running the seconds-long
analysis leg over the existing spells would LAUNDER the decimals rather than fix them: the
spells must be rebuilt first (~8.7h).
The VERDICT is unaffected regardless. Max power 0.055 against a required 0.80, with 0/200
replicates estimable at n>=4000, is driven by prevalence 0.0041 -- a function of the
invariant treatment above. Decimals move; the conclusion does not.

stale_after_pr7.pending_invalidation: PR 7 (ghost-GK re-fit onto the canonical box constant)
why: The ICC leg is CURRENT today: it consumes GKDV arm values (ghost-GK, DAS, threat pitch
control) and never touches the changed extractors, so 4.74.0 did not move it. PR 7 re-fits
ghost-GK, which feeds those arm values, and will.
Recorded as a third class deliberately. A two-way invariant/stale split would assert that icc
is simply current and be wrong two PRs later, with no mechanism to revisit. The artifact
already distinguishes the legs -- upstream_provenance.spells and upstream_provenance.arm_values
carry DIFFERENT run_commit values -- so the split is available in the data, not invented here.

rebuild.owner: spec item 21 (post-PR-7 rebuild), scheduled by Cycle B's invalidation report
once_not_thrice: Three sources invalidate this artifact -- PR 5 (theta, a build-time spell column), PR 6
LAYER2_CONFOUNDERS), and PR 7 (ghost re-fit -> the ICC leg). It is rebuilt ONCE after PR 7,

caveat_on_precision: See spec K10. The causal placebo bands are quantized at 1/n_treated because estimate_att is
1:1 nearest-neighbour matching, so their printed digits overstate their resolution. Do not
quote a band to more than ~4 significant figures.
